summary: April was about getting Cancun to market. Two new Cancun blogs went live, a destination guide and a trip experience case study, adding to the growing blog catalog. The bigger story is organic search: Google sessions grew 71% month over month (14 to 24) as the published content starts to compound. Total website sessions hit 111, up modestly from March. LinkedIn impressions stayed low while we held posts for the Cancun carousel launch in early May. The LinkedIn ads pilot was presented; the decision was to revisit in the fall.

metrics.note: Up 7% from 104 in March. Organic search up 71%.

findings.title: Organic Search Is Compounding
findings.description: Google organic sessions grew from 14 in March to 24 in April, a 71% jump. The blog catalog is starting to do real work in search. As more destination content publishes, this should keep trending up.

findings.title: Two New Cancun Blogs Now Live
findings.description: The Cancun destination guide and Cancun trip experience case study both published this month. They're already showing up in traffic and they round out the content trio (Costa Rica, Banff, Cancun) anchoring organic growth.

actions.description: Published a full Cancun and Riviera Maya group travel guide on the website.

actions.title: Cancun Trip Experience Case Study
actions.description: Published the spring break case study covering 347 students across 6 groups.

actions.title: Cancun LinkedIn Carousels
actions.description: Drafted and designed two LinkedIn carousel posts for the Cancun trip. Shipped early May.

actions.description: Presented the corporate-targeted ads pilot at our April 8 meeting. Decision was to revisit in the fall.

actions.title: LinkedIn Article Versions of Cancun & Costa Rica Blogs
actions.description: Adapting both blog sets into LinkedIn article format to extend reach beyond the website.
